title: Nvidia Stock (NVDA) Falls 3.3% on CEO Transition Concerns (Nov 19)
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) fell 3.30% to $145.98 on Nov 19, 2026, as The Motley Fool tied the drop to leadership and AI-spending concerns after its CEO resigned.
body_markdown:
## Why Nvidia Stock Fell


According to[The Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-today-nov-19-222025646.html) , strong third-quarter results, a raised outlook and investor excitement over[Anthropic's IPO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/anthropic-ipo-prices-83-raises-81-billion/) supported shares early, but "leadership and AI-spending concerns ultimately outweighed these factors." The outlet said Huang's resignation continued to weigh on shares as investors recalibrate that risk alongside the earnings beat.


According to[NVIDIA's official release](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition) dated November 12, Huang resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer and a member of the Board, effective immediately. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress is serving as Interim CEO while keeping her finance role, and the board is searching for a permanent successor among internal and external candidates. The release did not give a reason for the resignation.


The Motley Fool added that fallout from Huang's departure included US rules tightened on Monday to prevent Chinese businesses from remotely accessing advanced Nvidia AI chips through overseas data centers. It said this added to fears of further regulation of the AI sector.


After the close,[Investing.com reported](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/california-ag-subpoenas-nvidia-over-232352666.html) that California Attorney General Rob Bonta served an investigative subpoena on Nvidia on Thursday. The probe asks whether the company misled investors about potential leaks of advanced technology and confidential information to China. The report also cited a Wall Street Journal story that the Securities and Exchange Commission opened a civil investigation into Nvidia earlier this week, and it carried no comment from Nvidia.


## NVDA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- As reported by The Motley Fool, Nvidia's fiscal third-quarter[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) showed record revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year.
- Management forecast fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of about $130 billion, which The Motley Fool said was ahead of Wall Street expectations.
- Nvidia said its new Vera Rubin NVL72 has shipped, per The Motley Fool.
- According to Nvidia, Chair Harvey C. Jones said the company expects its operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption.


### Risks


- Nvidia is led by an interim CEO who is also its CFO, and the November 12 release set no timeline for naming a permanent successor.
- Nvidia faces the California subpoena and a reported SEC civil investigation into whether its disclosures misled investors, according to Investing.com.
- New US rules restrict Chinese businesses from remotely accessing advanced Nvidia AI chips through overseas data centers, according to The Motley Fool.
- The Motley Fool said Wall Street is still asking whether AI demand can justify the sector's pace of buildout.
